$comment: Known false positives for scripts/ci/scan-secrets.mjs. Each entry: path (a glob over repo-relative paths: ** any folders, * any name part), rule (a rule id from the script header, or * for every rule) and reason (why this is not a secret or a personal path). Never allowlist a real secret: remove it and rotate it.

entries.reason: Defines the absolute-path rule that this scanner mirrors; the matches are its pattern text, not paths (the test excludes itself the same way).
Upstream Blender manual (vendored, read-only legacy material): its asset-library example path, not a path of this project.
Search index built from the upstream Blender manual (data/ and its public/ copy); quotes the manual's example asset-library path.
Image index built from the upstream Blender manual (data/ and its public/ copy); quotes the manual's example asset-library path.

The memanto volume's mount point inside its container (the image user's home folder, unchanged since the initial commit), not a folder on any machine; reported once Phase 4 added the log limits to this file. The allowlist works per file and rule, so server/tests/vmStackConfig.test.js checks that this mount point stays the only path of this rule in the file.
